name: CLI
summary: CLI module is the kaioken command-line entry point: it parses argv into a Flags object, dispatches to one of fourteen subcommand runners (scan, symbols, search, serve, plan, cards, wiki, status, update, chat, verify, graph, export, research), and bundles its own model and web-search adapters so individual commands do not pick providers.
keyPoints: main.ts owns the full UX surface: parseArgs(argv) returns a Flags interface (or null on --help), and the USAGE constant documents every command, flag and depth multiplier in one block — commands like scan, chat and research are plug-ins that just return Promise<number> exit codes.

Commands are isolated in apps/cli/src/commands/ and share no types beyond Flags; chat.ts owns a 400-line interactive loop (runChat, converse, ChatHooks, ChatSessionCache) with a session-level prompt/abort protocol, while scan.ts, research.ts and serve.ts are single-purpose runners (runScan, runResearch, runServe) that depend on knowledge.ts to load .kaioken/scan.json and .kaioken/index.json.

Model and web layers live next to the dispatcher, not in each command: model.ts resolves a provider/model via --model, .kaioken/model.json or $KAIOKEN_MODEL using @earendil-works/pi-ai, and web.ts exposes httpFetchPort plus Tavily/DuckDuckGo WebSearchPort factories (TAVILY_API_KEY else DuckDuckGo) — chat and research reuse these so a missing provider fails the command before any user-visible work.

entryPoints.name: main
entryPoints.note: Top-level argv entry; calls parseArgs and routes to the matching runX command.

entryPoints.name: parseArgs
entryPoints.note: Turns argv into a Flags object or null; encodes the option grammar shared with USAGE.

entryPoints.name: runChat
entryPoints.note: Interactive chat agent; accepts ChatHooks for prompting/aborting and returns an exit code.

entryPoints.name: runResearch
entryPoints.note: Web-research command that fetches pages and verifies citations.

entryPoints.name: runScan
entryPoints.note: Walks the repo, flags risky files and writes the declaration inventory consumed by every other command.

entryPoints.name: runServe
entryPoints.note: Local browser UI for the indexed knowledge (port 7777 by default).

entryPoints.name: loadKnowledge
entryPoints.note: Reads .kaioken/scan.json and .kaioken/index.json with an optional force reload.

entryPoints.name: resolveModelClient
entryPoints.note: Picks a provider/model per Flags and returns a ResolvedClient with a human-readable describe string.

entryPoints.name: httpFetchPort
entryPoints.note: Timeout/size-capped HTML fetch (20s, 2 MiB) used by research before sanitisation.
